bottom_line: Prices are still climbing too fast. US inflation hit 3.8%, and the odds that the Fed (the people who set interest rates) raises rates again in December are now close to 100%. That means borrowing stays expensive and could get more expensive.

stories.title: Inflation hot, rate hike likely
stories.real: US inflation rose to 3.8% in October, and the Fed's favorite inflation measure hit a three-year high. Traders now put the odds of a December rate hike at almost 100%, and gold fell to its lowest point in over a year on that bet.
stories.you: Credit cards, car loans and mortgages could cost more, but savers can get more: some CDs pay up to 5.10%.

stories.title: New tariffs on 14 countries
stories.real: The US plans new tariffs (taxes on imported goods) on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU. Countries that sign trade deals with Washington are being offered lower rates, and global markets fell on the news.
stories.you: Tariffs can push up prices on imported stuff, which could keep interest rates higher for longer.
